fixtures.previous:
## Current state
- The billing-service monolith serves invoices, payments and dunning from one Rails app; the payments split into its own service is planned but not started. [S777a28c3]
- Invoices are generated by the nightly cron at 02:00 UTC (jobs/nightly_invoices.rb) and emailed in one batch once the run finishes. [S777a28c3]
- The customer portal reads invoices through the read replica billing-ro; writes always go to the primary. [Sd14a45eb]
- Stripe webhooks land in WebhooksController and are queued to the webhooks Sidekiq queue before any processing happens. [Sd14a45eb]
- The credit-notes feature is live for EU customers only, behind the CREDIT_NOTES_EU flag in config/flags.yml. [S3076c2d0]
- Usage-based pricing is computed from the usage_events table, rolled up hourly by UsageRollupJob into usage_hourly. [S3076c2d0]
- Refunds above the approval threshold wait in the refund_approvals queue for a finance reviewer before they are sent. [S2aa52e62]
- The PDF renderer is wkhtmltopdf pinned at 0.12.6; upgrading it changes line breaks in the invoice footer. [S2aa52e62]
## Decisions
- Money never moves through floats: the Money value object wraps amounts and currency together and is the only public type. [S777a28c3]
- Each invoice number is allocated from the invoice_numbers sequence per legal entity, never reused, never back-filled after voids. [S777a28c3]
- Customer-facing emails are rendered from app/views/mailers and translated through config/locales; no inline strings in mailers. [Sd14a45eb]
- Tax is calculated at invoice finalisation, not at line creation, so later rate changes do not rewrite drafts. [Sd14a45eb]
- Webhook handlers are idempotent on the event id and record every processed id in processed_events. [S3076c2d0]
- Background jobs that touch money run on the money Sidekiq queue with concurrency 1 per customer. [S3076c2d0]
- New endpoints are versioned under /api/v2; /api/v1 is frozen and only receives security fixes. [S2aa52e62]
- Feature flags live in config/flags.yml and are read through Flags.enabled?, never through ENV lookups. [Sa3ed9f3b]
## Unresolved
- Some EU invoices show a one-cent rounding gap against the ledger when a credit note spans two tax rates; cause not found yet. [S3076c2d0]
- The replica lag on billing-ro spikes above 30 seconds during month-end runs; the portal then shows stale balances. [S2aa52e62]
- A handful of webhook events arrive twice with different ids for the same charge; the dedupe key may need the charge id. [Sa3ed9f3b]
## Preferences & corrections
- Keep pull requests to one concern; migrations go in their own pull request ahead of the code that uses them. [S777a28c3]
- Use RSpec request specs for controllers rather than controller specs, which the team is phasing out. [Sd14a45eb]
- Name money columns with the _minor suffix and store the currency in a sibling _currency column. [Sd14a45eb]
- Prefer explicit service objects under app/services over model callbacks for anything that sends email or charges a card. [S3076c2d0]
- Ask before touching config/locales/*.yml; translators sync those files weekly and conflicts are painful. [S2aa52e62]
## Environment gotchas
- Local runs need the stripe-mock container on port 12111; without it the payment specs hang until timeout. [S777a28c3]
- bin/setup seeds two legal entities; specs that assume one entity fail with a confusing sequence error. [S777a28c3]
- The PDF specs need the DejaVu fonts installed; on a fresh machine run brew install --cask font-dejavu first. [Sd14a45eb]
- Sidekiq in development needs REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 because 6379 is used by another project. [Sd14a45eb]
- Time-dependent specs must freeze time with travel_to; Timecop is still in the Gemfile but no longer loaded. [S3076c2d0]
- The seed data uses the Europe/Berlin timezone for entity 2, so month-end specs run on Berlin midnight, not UTC. [S2aa52e62]
- CI runs specs in 8 shards; a spec that depends on ordering fails only on the shard where it lands first. [Sa3ed9f3b]
## Completed ✅ (last 7 days)
- 2026-09-19: moved dunning email templates into app/views/mailers/dunning and added missing translations. [S3076c2d0]
- 2026-09-20: added the processed_events uniqueness index and backfilled it for the last 90 days. [S2aa52e62]
- 2026-09-21: fixed the credit-note PDF footer overflow by shortening the legal text line. [S2aa52e62]
- 2026-09-22: split the money Sidekiq queue out of default and set its per-customer concurrency to 1. [Sa3ed9f3b]
- 2026-09-23: documented the refund approval threshold in docs/finance/refunds.md for the finance team. [Sa3ed9f3b]
